notes: Second pass found retrieval thin for NHS England page details (GP questions, high blood pressure/cholesterol, check-ups) and most hospital-leaflet and review claims; those were cut or re-attributed to the NHS trust page that was returned. BLT prevalence conflicts across its own pages (about 1 in 4 vs up to 1 in 5), so no figure is given. 'Most cases stay mild' was not stated in retrieved BLT text and was reworded. Urgent-care route now uses NHS (cirrhosis) wording instead of NHS 111 Wales alone. Final text contains one routing clause ('in the UK that would usually mean a GP appointment') that is general practice, not retrieved text (treated as the single textbook item); 'Fibrosis means scarring' is supported by BLT. Removed link to hypertension (risk factor not retrieved); kept cirrhosis, type-2-diabetes, liver-function-tests, biopsy, ultrasound, urlAliases (no clashes). Resmetirom is a US-only mention and is labelled. New references: NHS cirrhosis, NHS 111 Wales, NHS trust leaflet page, PMC review.
